jobs.name: 성채
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE ORIGINAL redesigned player spacecraft sprite for the existing 2D top-down game Rushitadel. Input image 1 is game world STYLE AND PALETTE reference only; image 2 is old player silhouette reference to improve, NOT a shape to copy. Use a transparent background, no scene, no text or labels, no shadow outside sprite. Orthographic overhead camera. Fit complete spacecraft with FIVE clearly countable small outward-facing turrets in centered square. Turret positions at 12 o'clock, 2:24, 4:48, 7:12, 9:36 (five equidistant radial stations around a central core). All guns have obvious short barrel, dark bore, and compact swiveling shoulder. Never add a sixth gun. One connected flying machine, no detached objects. Output enlarged pixel art that genuinely reads as a 48x48 logical pixel sprite: approximately 42 pixels overall diameter, 1 pixel dark charcoal outline, broad 2-3 tone armor shading, palette about 16 colors, no antialiasing, NO smooth painting or micro-detail. Medium detail, not flat icon: beveled large plates, one dark separation between plates, mechanically readable turret bases, tiny pale warm core and small restrained engine apertures. LESS surface noise than reference: no bolts, tiny pipes, scratches, hatching, narrow seams everywhere, or clutter. Each turret roughly 6-8 logical pixels long. Weapons distinguishable from hull by shape and lightness. Keep deliberate negative spaces. Muted desaturated antique mechanical fantasy: aged enamel, bronze accents, blue charcoal underframe, warm pale ivory pinpoint light; no neon, no bloom, no bright oversaturated colors. Must be legible against slate-purple terrain (#5c63a0). Attractive crafted pixel clusters, strong memorable symbol silhouette, interesting but immediately readable; balanced all-around combat silhouette. Square canvas, ship fills ~85% of canvas. This is a finished game sprite, not concept illustration, no perspective.
VARIANT DESIGN: A compact PENTAGONAL FLOATING CITADEL. Solid squat beveled pentagon chassis, five clipped bastion corners each supporting a stubby single rectangular gun. Slight inward recesses between the five corners. Broad ivory sandstone enamel armor panels, desaturated charcoal navy inner pentagon, antique brass narrow rim. Central small pentagonal warm reactor. Strong fortified heraldic badge silhouette. Five gun mount pads larger than barrels and visually separate from armor. Restrained two small ventilation notches. Feeling: reliable balanced defensive command craft. No pinwheel blades, no flower petals, no circular ring.
